title: Design System: Tikkun Reader Privacy and Support

display.purpose: Lora title in the introduction column.

title.purpose: Compact headings within the information panel.

motion.name: inherited-action-transition
motion.value: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease

motion.name: inherited-action-hover
motion.purpose: Existing action hover lift; no page entrance animation.

components.name: Support action
components.description: Existing mailto action with scoped contrast correction and inherited shape, focus, and motion.
components.css: .ds-support-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 0.85rem; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; margin-top: 0.5rem; background: #2164c7; color: #fff; font-family: var(--hebrew-ui-font-family, 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.75; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-support-action:hover { background: #286cce; color: #fff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-support-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(90, 157, 255, 0.9); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 620px) { .ds-support-action { width: 100%; } }

components.name: Information navigation
components.description: Actual two-link local navigation; current page receives an underline.
components.html: SupportPrivacy policy
components.css: .ds-information-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem 1.35rem; font-family: var(--hebrew-ui-font-family, 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-information-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--site-muted, rgba(235, 240, 247, 0.66)); text-decoration: none; } .ds-information-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--site-text, #f5f7fa); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.45em; text-decoration-color: var(--site-accent-soft, #79aaff); } .ds-information-nav a:hover { color: var(--site-text, #f5f7fa); } .ds-information-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(90, 157, 255, 0.9); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Information panel
components.description: Static reading container with a real excerpt from Support; no card hover behavior.
components.html:
A few details help

  • What you were trying to do, and what happened instead.
  • The reading and aliyah, or a link to the passage, if relevant.
  • Your device and browser or app version. A screenshot can help, too.
components.css: .ds-information-panel { min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--site-line-strong, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)); border-radius: 1rem; padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 3rem); background: var(--site-surface, rgba(15, 19, 25, 0.84)); color: var(--site-muted, rgba(235, 240, 247, 0.66)); font-family: var(--hebrew-ui-font-family, 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.75; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-information-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; color: var(--site-text, #f5f7fa); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-information-panel ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 1.25rem; } .ds-information-panel li + li { margin-top: 0.55rem; } .ds-information-panel li::marker { color: var(--site-accent-soft, #79aaff); }

narrative.overview: This reference applies only to `/privacy/` and `/support/`. It records the built extension of Tikkun's public site: the existing dark shell, ambient background, Lora titles, Noto Sans Hebrew reading text, blue links, and quiet borders. It neither replaces nor defines the global visual system.
dos: Do preserve the incumbent shell and the scoped two-column-to-stack composition.
Do retain the corrected support-action colors and white label in both default and hover states.
Do use actual project content, working route links, and the shared support contact source.
donts: Don't turn these page-specific measurements into global site rules.
Don't add decorative motion, generated raster assets, or invented UI primitives to this extension.
Don't treat visual or automated verification as approval of privacy claims: hosting configuration and support-mail retention require owner review before publication.
